subject: اللغة الإنجليزية
outcomes: Revise home technology words and phrasal verbs.
Use present tenses, future forms and adjective + preposition pairs.
Choose the right communication verbs like explain, translate and pronounce.

tf.s: Air conditioning keeps you cool in hot weather.
'The TV suddenly went off' means it stopped working.
You install an app onto a phone.
'I'm frightened at speaking in public' is correct.
'His lessons begin on Wednesday' can be used for a timetable.
'We took never them home' is correct.
tf.why: 'Never' goes before the main verb: 'We never took them home.'

tf.s: When your battery is low, you need to charge your phone.
'I usually am studying on Friday mornings' is correct for a habit.
tf.why: Habits use the present simple: 'I usually study.'

tf.s: We say 'Can you explain what you mean?'

boxes.q: Complete: I usually ___ on Friday mornings.
boxes.why: A habit takes the present simple.

boxes.q: Complete: This week I ___ extra hours.
boxes.why: 'This week' is around now, so we use the present continuous.

boxes.q: Rewrite with a phrasal verb: Make it louder!
Complete: You need to ___ the app first.
Complete the plan: Next year, we ___ learn Chinese.
Choose: Can you ___ what this word means?
boxes.why: We explain what a word means.

o: We often spent our holidays at the beach.
We spent often our holidays at the beach.
Often we our holidays spent at the beach.

boxes.q: Which word is a communication verb?
boxes.why: We pronounce words when we speak.

hunt.q: The TV stopped working. It went…
Say a word with the right sounds

mcq.q: Which item is used to wash plates?
Which phrasal verb means 'start working' for a light or machine?
When do we use the present continuous?
o: For actions happening now or around now

mcq.q: Rewrite with a phrasal verb: The heating starts working at 6 a.m.
o: The heating comes on at 6 a.m.
The heating goes off at 6 a.m.
The heating turns down at 6 a.m.
The heating plugs in at 6 a.m.

mcq.q: Order with 'never': we / take / them home (past)
Complete: I need to ___ this word into Arabic.
Why is 'begin' correct in 'His lessons begin on Wednesday'?
Which sentence uses a habit and an action around now correctly?
o: I usually study on Fridays, but this week I'm studying every day.
I'm usually studying on Fridays, but this week I study every day.
I study usually on Fridays, but this week I studying.
I usually studying on Fridays, but this week I study.
mcq.why: Habit = present simple; around now = present continuous.

mcq.q: Your phone stopped working because the battery is empty. What should you do?
o: Plug it in to charge it
